# Mozi Forge
A foundation for self-evolving AI agents, built on DeepSeek Harness.

Forge combines session evidence, feedback collection, reflection, training plans,
human plan approva

l, isolated evaluation, and autonomous verified integration. Agents propose improvements;
host servi
ces execute operations and preserve reviewable evidence.

Requirements: Node.js 24 or newer, Git, and pnpm 11.7.0. Install the pinned pnpm
version using Corep
ack or your package manager.
